In sparring contests, she would experiment with different scenarios to keep herself ready for competitions: down 0-6, as was the case in the final, down 0-10 and other such virtual situations.Manisha took up wrestling late in her life, introduced to it by her late father Suresh, who she still fondly refers to as "Father Sahab".Born in Siwaha, 10 km outside Jind in Haryana, Manisha took up wrestling to please her father. And the result of that is in front of you," he continued.Path to LA 2028 and shift to 57kg categoryThe big challenge for Manisha now is the shift to the 57kg category with the aim of not just qualifying for LA 2028 but winning a medal too.
